title: FXVCS pointer, format version 1 (decoded fields)
description: The pointer stored in Git in place of a large asset is a line-oriented UTF-8 text (grammar: pointer.abnf). This schema describes the decoded field set. Encoding is deterministic: keys appear once each in ascending byte order, one space separates key and value, every line ends with LF, no CRLF/BOM/comments/trailing whitespace, total size <= 1024 bytes. Bytes that decode but do not re-encode identically are rejected.

version.description: Pointer format version from the first line 'version https://fxvcs.dev/pointer/v1'.

domain.description: Storage domain that authorizes and deduplicates the object.

encoding.description: Encoding/chunking algorithm identifier and version, e.g. whole/1 or cdc-fastcdc/1.

manifest.description: Digest of the canonical object manifest (object-manifest-v1.schema.json).

oid.description: SHA-256 of the whole uncompressed file.
